Austria / Kitzbühel

Schlosshotel Kitzbühel

A five-star hotel just above Kitzbühel, a ten-minute walk from the centre. In winter the hotel's own shuttle runs to the cable car valley station; in summer a 9-hole golf course starts at the door.

Plan a stay hereAbout Kitzbühel

In short

What to know.

  • The Momentum Spa: 3,000 m², with an indoor pool with mountain views and an outdoor pool heated all year
  • The hotel's own shuttle to the Kitzbühel cable car valley station
  • A 9-hole golf course on the doorstep
  • Kitzbühel station 10 minutes away

Why we send guests here

Who it suits.

For guests who want the town and the Hahnenkamm close by, and a big spa to come back to.

Good to know.

EverFlow is your contact before and during your stay. The stay itself is provided by Schlosshotel Kitzbühel, under the hotel's terms.
